acceptance.given: For each applicable Consumer, the Candidate Route is approved and current, and a re-enable transition is executed.

oracle.expected: The re-enable receipt for every applicable Consumer records an actual invocation of the current approved Candidate Route and the captured current result, and the resulting state is re-enabled through that route.
forbidden: Any applicable Consumer has no Candidate Route invocation receipt.
The recorded route is unapproved or stale.
The Candidate Route invocation result is absent, inferred, or copied from another transition.
oracle.observable: Per-Consumer re-enable receipts in the runtime replay evidence identify the approved Candidate Route identity, show its real invocation, and contain the current result captured from that invocation.

acceptance.then: After re-enable execution completes, every applicable Consumer has a route-bound receipt proving the current approved Candidate Route was called and its current result was captured.
acceptance.when: A re-enable transition is executed for an applicable Consumer.

failure_intents.selector_intent: scripts/sc/tests/tc_d1_cer/test_s7.py::test_reenable_requires_real_candidate_route_invocation mutates the re-enable path so the Consumer does not call the Candidate Route; the validator must observe the expected-red failure.
scripts/sc/tests/tc_d1_cer/test_s7.py::test_reenable_rejects_stale_or_unapproved_candidate_route supplies a stale or unapproved Candidate Route identity; the validator must reject the receipt.
scripts/sc/tests/tc_d1_cer/test_s7.py::test_reenable_requires_current_result_capture removes the invocation result from the per-Consumer receipt; the validator must reject completion.

affected_subjects: Re-enable transition for every applicable Consumer through the approved Candidate Route
slice_hint.behavior_change: Implement or repair re-enable execution so each applicable Consumer performs a real call to the current approved Candidate Route and records that call's current result in its own receipt; stale, unapproved, omitted, or uncaptured route facts remain unsuccessful.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay receipt compatibility and route-transition semantics; rollback is limited to the re-enable invocation and receipt-capture implementation.

slice_hint.state_transition: approved-current Candidate Route, re-enable pending -> each applicable Consumer invokes Candidate Route and captures its current result -> re-enable complete only when all applicable Consumer receipts satisfy the route and result bindings.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Pass iff every applicable Consumer has a receipt bound to the current approved Candidate Route identity, a real invocation outcome, and the captured current result; otherwise fail with no successful re-enable verdict.

A policy without the Acceptance route is accepted.
The minimum supported route set is reduced.

acceptance.then: The VDD and Acceptance routes remain irreducible and required.
